title: DAAD-TEV-Master's degree scholarships
summary: Scholarships for outstanding Turkish students from all disciplines to pursue a Master's degree or part of a joint German-Turkish Master's degree at a German university.

degree_levels.notes: A Master's degree or part of a joint German-Turkish Master's degree programme

institutions.notes: a state or state-recognised German university

residence.notes: Country in which you are living and from which you are applying (Turkey)

mandatory.text: Convincing academic and personal reasons for the planned study project in Germany

funding.description: Monthly scholarship payment of 992 euros. Medical, accident and personal liability insurance. Travel allowance. TEV's share must be paid back to the foundation. Additional benefits may include a monthly rent subsidy and a pre-study language course.

sources.title: DAAD-TEV-Master's degree scholarships - DAAD - Deutscher Akademischer Austauschdienst
sources.notes: International students can receive funding for studying a Master's degree in Germany.
